title: R--DOE (EDF) Market Advisory Standing List Amendment
agency_path: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.HEADQUARTERS PROCUREMENT SERVICES
detail_text: Department of Energy’s (DOE) Energy Dominance Financing (EDF) has a need for Market advisory services to assist DOE in its credit analysis and evaluation of different loan applications. ***This has been extended through October 5, 2026. If you have responded to previous announcement, you are not required to respond again. No changes have been made to the requirements***.
